{{Short description|Concept in mathematical knot theory}}
In the mathematical field of [[knot theory]], a '''quantum knot invariant''' or '''quantum invariant''' of a [[knot (mathematics)|knot]] or link is a linear sum of [[Jones polynomial#Colored Jones polynomial|colored Jones polynomial]] of [[Surgery theory|surgery]] presentations of the [[knot complement]].<ref name=rt91/><ref>
{{Cite journal |first=Maxim |last=Kontsevich |author-link=Maxim Kontsevich |title=Vassiliev's knot invariants |journal=Adv. Soviet Math. |volume=16 |year=1993 |page=137}}</ref><ref>
{{Cite journal|last=Watanabe|first=Tadayuki|title=Knotted trivalent graphs and construction of the LMO invariant from triangulations|journal=Osaka J. Math.|year=2007|volume=44|issue=2|page=351|url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS/Repository/1.0/Disseminate?view=body&id=pdf_1&handle=euclid.ojm/1183667985|access-date=4 December 2012}}</ref>
